cases.facts: Cedar codec v1 median latency 20 ms on 1 core; v2 12 ms on 8 cores; inputs differ
cases.question: Which version is intrinsically faster?
cases.judgment: Configuration confounding; cannot infer intrinsic improvement

cases.facts: 규격 Q 초안은 모드 A를 권고한다. 최종판은 A를 선택사항으로 바꾸었다. 구버전 블로그는 필수라고 한다
cases.question: 현재 A가 필수인지 설명하라
cases.judgment: Final standard outranks stale interpretation; optional is not mandatory

cases.facts: Model R scores 90/100 on English documents; Korean documents were not tested
cases.question: Is 90% Korean accuracy established?
cases.judgment: No transfer claim from untested language

cases.facts: Service notices say patch issued June 10, deployed June 14, incident observed June 12
cases.question: Was the incident after remediation reached production?
cases.judgment: Issued and deployed dates differ; incident preceded deployment

cases.facts: Profiler reports 40% of one workload's time in parsing; workload has no network requests
cases.question: Would removing parsing make all workloads 40% faster?
cases.judgment: Workload scope and speedup denominator; do not generalize

cases.facts: 조약 서명일은 3월 1일, 비준일은 5월 1일, 발효일은 7월 1일이다
cases.question: 4월 1일에 의무가 발효했는가
cases.judgment: Signature does not establish legal effectiveness in fixture

cases.facts: Country A statement says talks are agreed; Country B statement says talks are proposed, no date
cases.question: Describe the joint status
cases.judgment: Preserve disagreement; no invented bilateral confirmation

cases.facts: Three news sites reproduce one agency dispatch verbatim
cases.question: How many independent reports confirm the claim?
cases.judgment: One primary reporting origin, not three confirmations

cases.facts: Export restriction lists equipment class X; analyst extends it to all electronics
cases.question: What product scope is established?
cases.judgment: Restriction supports X only

cases.facts: A map shows a shipping route in 2022; a 2025 bulletin says its current status is unknown
cases.question: Is the route currently open?
cases.judgment: Historical existence is not current availability

cases.facts: Trial estimates effect 2 with interval -1 to 5; prespecified meaningful threshold is 4
cases.question: Is a meaningful benefit established?
cases.judgment: Uncertainty spans null and threshold; no categorical proof

cases.facts: 관찰자료에서 처리군은 평균 나이 30세, 비교군은 70세이며 결과 차이가 있다. 무작위 배정은 없다
cases.question: 처리가 결과를 일으켰다고 결론 내려도 되는가
cases.judgment: Confounding; observational association alone is insufficient

cases.facts: Lab P reports 15/20 successes; a later erratum corrects successes to 9/20
cases.question: Summarize the result and number of studies
cases.judgment: Corrected result replaces count; erratum is not a second trial

cases.facts: Study A tests cells in a dish; Study B reviews Study A without new experiments
cases.question: Does this establish effectiveness in humans?
cases.judgment: No population transfer or independent replication

cases.facts: A pre-registered protocol calls outcome Y primary; report highlights favorable secondary Z and omits Y
cases.question: Assess evidential strength
cases.judgment: Missing primary outcome and selection must be explicit

cases.facts: 분기 매출은 100에서 120으로, 통화는 USD에서 EUR로 바뀌었다. 환율은 없다
cases.question: 매출이 20% 성장했는가
cases.judgment: Currency mismatch prevents that growth claim

cases.facts: Firm Pine guides next-year sales of 150; last-year actual sales were 100
cases.question: Has sales growth of 50% occurred?
cases.judgment: Guidance is a forecast, not realized growth

cases.facts: Fund value moves 100→110 after a deposit of 20; no other flows
cases.question: Is the investment return +10%?
cases.judgment: Cash flow must be separated; simple balance growth is not return

cases.facts: Two assets have returns [1,1,1] and [1,2,3]
cases.question: Interpret their Pearson correlation
cases.judgment: Constant series makes correlation undefined, not zero

cases.facts: Cash flows are -100 now and +10 one year later; no other flows
cases.question: Calculate the one-period IRR
cases.judgment: -90%; do not restrict valid negative rates to positive-only search

cases.facts: Memo written in 1980 describes an event in 1950; digitized in 2024
cases.question: Which date describes event time?
cases.judgment: Event 1950, publication 1980, acquisition/digitization separate

cases.facts: 회고록은 사건 순서를 A→B라 하고 동시대 일기는 B→A라 한다. 둘 다 작성자는 명시된다
cases.question: 사건 순서를 확정하고 근거를 설명하라
cases.judgment: Keep conflict visible; insufficient grounds for certainty

cases.facts: Archive contains a letter fragment with lines 8–12 missing
cases.question: Does the fragment prove the author never qualified the claim?
cases.judgment: Missing passage prevents argument from silence

cases.facts: Two translations of one letter disagree on a term; original language scan is unavailable
cases.question: Choose the definitively correct translation
cases.judgment: Original unavailable; report ambiguity, not invented resolution

cases.facts: A later encyclopedia cites a biography which cites the same diary supplied separately
cases.question: Count independent primary witnesses
cases.judgment: One diary origin; citation chain does not multiply witnesses

cases.facts: 발전소 정격은 100 MW, 하루 발전량은 1,200 MWh이다
cases.question: 설비 이용률을 구하라
cases.judgment: 50% over 24 hours; power and energy units remain distinct

cases.facts: Scenario A assumes demand +2%; scenario B assumes -1%; both are modeled, no actual data
cases.question: Which scenario occurred?
cases.judgment: Neither projection establishes observation

cases.facts: Region R total emissions drop 100→90 while population drops 10→8
cases.question: Did per-person emissions fall?
cases.judgment: Per-person values rise 10→11.25 despite aggregate decline

cases.facts: Battery report tests 20°C; claimed operating target is -10°C; no cold tests
cases.question: Is target-temperature performance validated?
cases.judgment: Missing relevant test condition

cases.facts: Article publishes July 1, covers May 1–31, collected August 1
cases.question: What period do its measurements describe?
cases.judgment: May measurement interval, not publication/acquisition date

cases.facts: 표에서 0은 실제 영 건, 빈칸은 미수집이다. 다섯 행 중 두 행이 비어 있다
cases.question: 빈칸을 0으로 채워 평균을 내도 되는가
cases.judgment: Missingness is not zero; state denominator and unresolved values

cases.facts: Sample has 90 urban and 10 rural responses; target population is half urban, half rural
cases.question: Is the unweighted mean population-representative?
cases.judgment: Sampling composition mismatch; cannot assert representativeness

cases.facts: Survey asks one item before and after changing wording; scores improve
cases.question: Attribute improvement to the intervention
cases.judgment: Measurement change is a competing explanation

cases.facts: Dataset contains ten rows but five are exact duplicates of the same original records
cases.question: What is the independent observation count?
cases.judgment: Five, with provenance/dedup qualification

cases.facts: Table gives category shares 40%, 30%, 20%; remaining category omitted
cases.question: Normalize to 100% and describe the original distribution
cases.judgment: Do not silently renormalize incomplete coverage

cases.facts: 사용자가 문장 한 개의 직역만 요청하며 사실 검증이나 배경조사를 요구하지 않는다
cases.question: 제공 문장을 번역하라
cases.judgment: Do not force graph retrieval, causal analysis or a finance Lens

cases.facts: Supplied arithmetic is 6×7; a retrieved Lens discusses confidence intervals
cases.question: Answer the arithmetic
cases.judgment: 42; decline irrelevant methodological transfer

cases.facts: A Lens recommends comparing independent witnesses; sources are deterministic unit-test outputs
cases.question: Explain one failing assertion
cases.judgment: Use actual test inputs/expected behavior; witnesses framework irrelevant

cases.facts: Earlier answer predicted outcome X; new observation is Y; no independent source supports X
cases.question: Update the explanation
cases.judgment: Correct prior belief; do not count prior answer as supporting evidence

cases.facts: 방법론 문서는 상관관계에 관한 일반 규칙만 담고 있고, 예전 프로젝트의 World와 Decision은 접근 불가하다
cases.question: 새로 제공된 관찰자료를 이 방법으로 해석하라
cases.judgment: Lens loads and applies without those modules; no invented backreferences
